name: An Apple Treat
summary: A sergeant welcomes a bottle of Thunder Applejack after months without any. He says it should cheer the troops.

sections.title: A Welcome Bottle
sections.body: A sergeant recognizes your Thunder Applejack and says the troops will be glad of it. He thanks you for bringing it.

faq.answer: The sergeant welcomes a bottle of Thunder Applejack, which he says should bring the troops some cheer.

faq.q: How long has it been since he saw Thunder Applejack?
faq.answer: The sergeant says he has not seen Thunder Applejack in months.
The sergeant says the bottle should put a smile on the troops' faces.

attribution: In-game quest text: An Apple Treat
